_comment: Follow-up and context-dependent question vectors (docs/phase5-apply-agent-spec.md 7.1). 'key' is questionKey(text). 'needs_label_key' is whether the key is a follow-up, an opener or too short to stand on its own words, so a saved answer is never matched on it alone; 'context_dependent' adds the employer-relative wording, so a reusable answer never travels to another company. The engine's needsLabelKey and contextDependent (apps/extension/apply-engine.js) and apply_policy.needs_label_key and context_dependent must agree on every row. Node runs this in tests/extension/run_tests.mjs; the Python suites reuse this file.
